label_image_with_text: label an image with text using OpenCV and custom font color and position
label_image_custom_font: label an image with text using a custom font scale and thickness
to_device_transfer_tensors: transfer a nested dict of PyTorch tensors to a CUDA device
to_device_transfer_module: transfer a PyTorch nn.Module to a specified device
to_device_transfer_list: transfer a list of PyTorch tensors to a CUDA device non-blocking
